title: Biotechnology Research Lab Assistant
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Biotechnology Research Lab Assistant - Certificate of Achievement (CA)
outcomes: Using a laboratory notebook to apply principles of proper documentation and recordkeeping, and create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
Explain and accurately perform molecular biology techniques commonly used in biotechnology-related academic and industrial laboratories.
Analyze and clearly present biotechnology data in both oral and written formats.
Master essential laboratory techniques, including precise weighing, expert liquid handling, buffer formulation, and aseptic techniques.
Operate and maintain laboratory equipment, troubleshoot issues, and perform routine maintenance tasks.
Adhere to safety protocols and best practices in laboratory environments.
Demonstrate teamwork and communication skills essential for collaborative research and professional interactions.

notes: Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (BIOTECH 002, MICRO 020, CHEM 051, CHEM 065) and without a space (STATC1000, STATC1000E); these were matched to closed-list BIOTECH 2, BIOTECH 3, MICRO 20, CHEM 51, CHEM 65, STAT C1000, STAT C1000E.

STAT 001 and STAT 001S appear only in a parenthetical note saying they 'can be substituted for STATC1000 or STATC1000E'; recorded as alternatives with catalog_addition true and no units, since none are printed in this section.
The outcomes are printed under the heading 'Program Learning Objectives'.
'Total Units 20-21' is the certificate total; no separate block total is printed.
The text following page 52 belongs to the Business Administration 2.0 AS-T and was not used.
